info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Mergers and Acquisitions API
info.description: The Mergers and Acquisitions API provides essential access to data surrounding merger and acquisition activities within the corporate finance sector. This API enables users to retrieve detailed information on various M&A transactions, facilitating informed decision-making and strategic planning for investors and corporate stakeholders. Typical consumers include financial analysts, corporate development teams, and investment bankers who require insights into market trends and transactional data. With comprehensive endpoint capabilities, this API supports analysis, reporting, and research purposes.

get.summary: Retrieve information on mergers and acquisitions.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information regarding mergers and acquisitions in the corporate finance sector. It provides insights into recent activities, trends, and key players involved in these transactions.
